newsitem.title: ITALY: Credito Bergamasco shares rise in Milan.
newsitem.headline: Credito Bergamasco shares rise in Milan.

text.p: Shares in Italian banking group Credito Bergamasco rose on the Milan bourse after reports Credit Lyonnais will need to sell-off all its interests outside France in return for the approval of a rescue package, dealers said.

A report in the Financial Times said the European Commission was expected to tell the French state-owned bank that it must sell all its remaining European banking operations outside its national base in return for the EC approval of its rescue plan.
At 1040 GMT, shares in Credito Bergamasco were up 2.01 percent lire at 25,350 lire. Credit Lyonnais has a controlling stake in the Bergamo-based bank.
Newspaper reports have suggested Credito Italiano and Banca Commerciale Italiana were interested in Credito Bergamasco, but neither has expressed a formal interest.
